messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED: Increased p99 tail latency observed on streaming inference endpoints (region-us-west). Auto-alert triggered at 2026-02-28T03:10:32Z. Trigger: p99 > 10s for 5m.

alice_ng: saw the alert, digging into traces now. p95 up a bit but p99 is spiking to ~12s.

ben_h: any obvious deploys around 03:05?

carla_ops: looks like a config push to controlplane at 03:02 (feature flags service). rolling 3/5 pods succeeded, 2 are still restarting per K8s.

dinesh_sre: grabbing dashboard: `infra/controlplane/auth-service` latency shows auth token validation p99 spiking to 2000ms, coupled with configfetch 5xxs.

metrics-bot: Metric snapshot: stream.inference.latency.p95=450ms, p99=12.4s. error_rate (5m) +0.9%. backend.auth.5xx +3.2%.

eve_pm: Customer impact: several streaming customers report stalls and reconnects. CS has one high-traffic enterprise (AcmeCorp) on a dedicated route.

cs-rep: AcmeCorp reporting degraded streaming during window 03:07-03:20, tried reconnecting. They saw partial responses then stalls.

alice_ng: Trace sample: request spends ~9s waiting in `auth-token-cache` path, then retries to controlplane for feature flags. Many requests hit feature-flag-store and got 503.

ben_h: hypothesis: controlplane configfetch/featureflags DB backend is overloaded -> auth/feature flag calls blocking inference path -> tail latency.

carla_ops: rolling restarts might have triggered cold cache on flags. We also had a spike of configfetch from a bad agent at 03:01 (old SDK polling loop).

alice_ng: can we short-circuit: fallback to local defaults for feature flags and skip configfetch for streaming-critical path?

dinesh_sre: oncall action plan: 1) enable local feature-flag fallback for streaming service (fast patch), 2) increase auth token in-memory TTL to avoid roundtrip, 3) rate-limit configfetch clients emitting excessive traffic, 4) monitor p99. I'll run 1 & 2 first.

ben_h: +1. How do we toggle the fallback? is there a runtime flag?

carla_ops: yes: `FEATUREFLAGS_FALLBACK=local` via configmap. I'll push to streaming-deploy. Command: 
```
kubectl set env deployment/streaming-service FEATUREFLAGS_FALLBACK=local -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/streaming-service -n prod
```

alice_ng: patching auth client to extend TTL: `AUTH_CACHE_TTL=300` for streaming-service. Applying as env var.

carla_ops: applying both now. restarting 6 pods one at a time. rolling restart started.

incident-bot: Action logged: `enable-featureflag-fallback` by carla_ops at 2026-02-28T03:16:12Z.

dinesh_sre: also throttled configfetch calls from legacy-agent group to 5r/s using ingress rate limit.

metrics-bot: 2m after changes: p99 dropped from 12.4s -> 2.1s, p95 -> 420ms. error_rate for auth down to baseline.

alice_ng: still seeing some taily 4-6s spikes for a small subset, digging into per-user routing. Might be related to token DB record contention for certain accounts.

ben_h: how about fallback policy for auth? we can serve short-lived tokens from local cache if DB response > 800ms. Could be a quick code toggle.

dinesh_sre: short-term we can add a circuit-breaker: if auth-db latency > 800ms for >1m, start local-cached-token mode. I'll open runbook step.

carla_ops: restarted the last pod at 03:19, all streaming pods back up. rolling restart completed.

metrics-bot: 10m after mitigation: p99=650ms, p95=380ms. streaming reconnects trending down.

cs-rep: CS notified AcmeCorp at 03:24 with mitigation steps. they acknowledged but ask for RCA and ETA for full fix.

alice_ng: root cause draft: cascading effect from a config service deploy + a noisy legacy SDK polling clients that drained the feature flag cache and added load to controlplane DB, increasing auth/configfetch latency and producing streaming tail stalls.

eve_pm: severity recommendation: Sev2 (partial degradation for multiple customers). recommend post-incident follow-up: - limit legacy agent polling, - add better featureflag cache warming, - add auth token local fallback, - add better observability for per-tenant token DB contention.

dinesh_sre: handoff notes for night oncall (@oncall-night): mitigations applied, p99 back near baseline but watch auth-db latency and legacy-agent traffic. If p99 > 2s again: revert to sticky-secondary routing for AcmeCorp, escalate to DB infra.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, impact reduced. Current status: recovering.

carla_ops: adding links: Dashboards -> https://grafana.redwood.example/d/streaming/stream-latency, Traces -> https://jaeger.redwood.example/search?trace=auth-spike, Logs query -> `prod_streaming | json | status>=500 | limit 50`.

ben_h: putting together a short postmortem. I'll include timeline and action items.

cs-rep: any ETA on when we can share RCA with AcmeCorp?

eve_pm: aim to have initial RCA and mitigations summary by EOD. full RCA next week after DB team investigation.

carla_ops: handoff complete to @oncall-night. leaving runbook and links in the oncall doc.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: monitoring. Closure candidate in 24h if stable.
